soldier: Apex of the labrum pointed and bluntly rounded, apical setae present, subapical setae distinct, lateral apical setae slender and short, almost indiscernible. Mandibles long and strong, apex rather strongly curved, mandibular basal ridge discernible; length 0.58–0.62 of head capsule length and 0.92–0.98 of head width. Antennae 16–18 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior sixth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal and widening posteriorly, the middle section shallowly concave; waist region slender and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.28–0.32. Pronotum kidney-shaped, 1.63–1.74 times as wide as long, anterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs with a prominent incision in the middle, lateral margins and posterior margin forming an arc, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; about 4 long setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
